title: Logical Replication & CDC
description: Publish and subscribe to table changes, replicate across different PostgreSQL versions, and power Change Data Capture (CDC).

data.text: While physical streaming replication replicates the entire cluster at the disk block level, **Logical Replication** operates on a **publish/subscribe model** for individual tables. It decodes WAL records into logical row changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

data.title: Configuring Publication and Subscription
data.content: Replicating specific tables across distinct databases.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Logical replication works across different major PostgreSQL versions (e.g. PG 14 to PG 16).
Allows replicating a subset of tables or filtering by rows.
Forms the foundation for Change Data Capture (CDC) with tools like Debezium and Kafka.
